top_news.title: New Archestra's OpenAPPA Saturates Two Major Security Benchmarks with a 0% Attack Success Rate
top_news.dek: Archestra has launched OpenAPPA, an open-source security engine designed to prevent data exfiltration from prompt injection and model hallucinations.
top_news.brief: OpenAPPA operates outside the agent's execution loop, utilizing deterministic rules based on data sources, trust levels, and authorities. In testing against Bench-Corp and AgentThreatBench, the engine achieved a 0% attack success rate, outperforming existing benchmarks like Claude Code and Microsoft FIDES.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing OpenAPPA architecture outside the agent execution loop

top_news.title: Models ranked by normative score across twelve paradigms, once neutral and once human-primed
top_news.dek: The Cognit leaderboard evaluates LLM responses across twelve normative paradigms under both neutral and human-primed conditions.
top_news.brief: Cognit ranks models based on their ability to provide normative answers, measuring the 'frame drop' between neutral prompts and those primed with human bias. The leaderboard currently tracks six models across 144 trials, with an average normative score of 75.7%.
top_news.image_alt: Screenshot of the Cognit leaderboard showing model rankings and normative scores

primary.title: NASA and IBM's open source lunar model turns 17 years of orbiter data into a foundation for lunar science
primary.summary: NASA and IBM have released the Lunar Foundation Model, one of the first open-source AI models for lunar science.
